title: Servers Switcher
description: Switch between servers and reconnect instantly from your Pause menu without returning to the Main Menu
body:
### Tired of the "Main Menu" loop? 
Every time you want to switch from a survival server to a creative test server, you have to disconnect, wait for the menu to load, find the server, and click again. ServerSwitcher fixes this by bringing your server list directly into the game.

![Menu](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a89bbb09272bcc119d81dbf05b26c59cf77a4cbb.png)

### Key Features
Quick-Access Menu: A new "Switch Server" button added directly to your Escape (Pause) menu (or you can bind it).

![Menu2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c67c0bb56878f7c418dc32375bd830a9fed0f4ae_0.webp)

### One-Click Reconnect:
Lagging out? Need to refresh your proxy connection? Use the dedicated Reconnect button to rejoin your current server instantly.

![Reconect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ace1dc8183a3000a5a1c42f87058eb714df4f6a.gif)

### Server List Integration:
It automatically pulls all servers from your existing servers.dat file. No need to re-add them!


![Conect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e999f4b044ec0c266427ba30a22ccf69fbd774cc.gif)

### Purely Client-Side:
You can use this on any server without needing any server-side plugins.
